$comment: Which life-grammar numbers are measured, fitted, or invented. Same honesty contract as param-coverage.json for planets.

measured.note: CRC / standard physical constants for water, ammonia, methane, formamide, sulfuric acid.
Boiling points at 1 bar; supercritical CO2 is tagged invented.
B ∝ M^0.75, generation time and lifespan ~ M^0.25.
μL < 1 error threshold; ~10 kb unproofread RNA ceiling.
~10% of energy crosses each trophic step (Lindeman).

fitted.note: Hand-written GUILDS yield column, now also a ΔG sketch from concentrations.
Arrhenius exponent compressed /8 so Titan is slow rather than 10^−15.
Logistic colonisation terms so a viable guild actually grows.
Prior so Earth-like worlds originate inside a stated Hadean/Archean window.

invented.note: Honest microwave eye; nothing on Earth does this.
Per-band utility column in sensors.json is a design weight, not a measurement.
Energy carrier analogue; chemically fragile in water.
